Ratchet & Clank(RC) HD Collection was released in 2012 and contains three games: Ratchet & Clank(2002), Ratchet & Clank: Going Commando (2003), and Ratchet & Clank: Up Your Arsenal (2005). The collection is on PS3 and Vita, while all of the games originally came out on PS2. The games were developed by Insomniac Studio while the HD edition was done by Idol Minds, and the games were all publish by Sony Computer Entertainment. I got the game new from Gamestop for $30 a while back, on average the game is $20-25.

The games' stories follows the characters Ratchet and Clank getting together to save the galaxy in each game. In the first game the two meet by accident and get thrown into a series of events. When Ratcher and Clank first meet, they don't get along at all, and are pretty much just stuck together. Ratchet is a selfish asshole that looks out only for himself while Clank wants to find Capetian Qwark to help save the universe. In R&C Going Commando, the duo ends up taking a contract in another galaxy to help Megacrop recover an experiment which leads to yet another turn of events. In R&C Up Your Arsenal, Ratchet and Clank are called to Ratchet's home world, Veldin, which is under attack by the Tyhrranoids under control by Dr. Nefarious whose plans are to turn everyone in the galaxy into robots. This leads Ratchet and Clank to try and stop him. One of the best things in this game series are all of the side characters which adds a lot of depth to the game.

Gameplay:

All three games have the same element of being a 3D action platformer. In each game you always get a multitude of weapons and gadgets to help you fight and solve puzzles along the way. With each new entry to the series, the controls are improved upon. In the first game the controls can be a little rough at time but not unplayable, and by the third game, the controls are nearly perfect. The weapons are also evolving in each game, in the first game there just your basic weapons while in next two games they add both leveling your weapons up to make them stronger and have new abilities. The series has a lot of great weapons, from the Morph-O-Ray which turns enemies into chickens, The Bouncer which shoots one bomb and turns into many bouncing balls, and the RYNO(rip U a new one) which fires an onslaught of rockets and bullets.

Each game always features good side events, too. In the first game, you have the hoverboard racing, and in Going Commando you have Hooverbike races and gladiator arenas. In Up Your Arsenal you have a more expanded arena with an obstacle course and big battles with vehicles.

Overall I give Ratchet and Clank HD Collection a 10/10. It's a great pick for it's price and amount of play time, with each game taking about 10hrs+ and all three have new game plus to play through again. All of the characters are great in this series and with each new game, the series matures. Thank you for reading through.
